text:
Branded residences are most commonly associated with **luxury and upper-upscale hotel brands**, which provide the name, design standards, amenities, and often ongoing property management or hospitality services. Hotel brands represent roughly four-fifths of completed branded-residence developments globally. ([pdf.savills.com](https://pdf.savills.com/documents/Savills-Branded-Residences-Annual-Report-2025-2026.pdf))

## Most prominent global brands

According to Savills’ 2025/26 global leaderboard, the hotel brands with the largest completed and planned residential footprints include:

1. **The Ritz-Carlton**
2. **Four Seasons**
3. **St. Regis**
4. **Mandarin Oriental**
5. **W Hotels**
6. **Rosewood**
7. **Fairmont**
8. **Aman**
9. **Autograph Collection**
10. **Six Senses** ([pdf.savills.com](https://pdf.savills.com/documents/Savills-Branded-Residences-Annual-Report-2025-2026.pdf))

## Common brands by hotel group

| Hotel group/operator | Brands commonly used for residences |
|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | The Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, W, EDITION, JW Marriott, The Luxury Collection, Autograph Collection |
| **Accor** | Fairmont, Raffles, Sofitel, SLS, SO/, Mondrian, Delano |
| **Four Seasons** | Four Seasons Private Residences |
| **Hilton** | Waldorf Astoria, Conrad, LXR Hotels & Resorts |
| **Hyatt** | Park Hyatt, Andaz, Thompson Hotels, The Standard, Miraval, Grand Hyatt |
| **IHG Hotels & Resorts** | Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Kimpton |
| **Banyan Group** | Banyan Tree, Angsana, Cassia |
| **Kerzner International** | One&Only Private Homes |
| **Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group** | The Residences at Mandarin Oriental |
| **Rosewood Hotel Group** | Rosewood Residences |
| **Aman Group** | Aman Residences |
| **Kempinski** | Kempinski Residences |
| **Minor Hotels** | Anantara Residences |
| **Jumeirah** | Jumeirah Residences |
| **Emaar Hospitality** | Address Residences, Vida Residences, Palace Residences |
| **Radisson Hotel Group** | Radisson Collection and selected Radisson-branded residences |
| **Wyndham Hotels & Resorts** | Wyndham, Registry Collection and selected upscale brands |

Marriott is the largest parent group in the sector, followed by Accor; other major parent-level participants include Four Seasons, Hilton, Banyan Group, Hyatt, Radisson, IHG and Wyndham. ([pdf.savills.com](https://pdf.savills.com/documents/Savills-Branded-Residences-Annual-Report-2025-2026.pdf)) Hyatt specifically identifies Park Hyatt, Thompson, Andaz, The Standard and Miraval among its growing residential portfolio, while IHG operates residences under Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental and Kimpton. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/may-30-2025-unscriptedbyhyatt?utm_source=openai))

### Practical shortlist

For a developer seeking brands with the strongest established association with branded residences, the core shortlist would normally be:

**Ritz-Carlton, Four Seasons, St. Regis, Mandarin Oriental, Rosewood, Fairmont, W, Aman, Six Senses, Waldorf Astoria, Raffles, One&Only, Park Hyatt and Kempinski.**

The appropriate brand ultimately depends on the project’s positioning: **ultra-luxury** brands such as Aman or Four Seasons suit low-density premium projects, while **luxury-lifestyle** brands such as W, SLS, Andaz or Mondrian tend to suit larger urban and mixed-use developments.
